transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net, this is Mia. How can I help?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hi Mia. I'm abroad in Spain, and my phone's just stopped working for data. Calls are fine but no internet at all, which is really inconvenient because I need maps.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Being abroad without maps is stressful, I'm sorry, Declan. Can I take your full name and date of birth?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Declan Murphy, thirtieth of June, eighty-five.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Is data roaming switched on in your phone settings?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I'm not sure. How do I check?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: On your phone, go to settings, mobile data, and look for data roaming. Is it on or off?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Switch that on. Is the network showing at the top of the screen, like Movistar or Vodafone ES?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Good. Did you use up your roaming allowance? I can see you have Roam Like Home on your plan, with twenty gigs.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Then switching roaming on should do it. Can you try opening maps?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It's loading now. Yes, maps is working.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Great, so your data works in Spain now. Is there anything else I can help with?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for choosing S-Net, Declan. Enjoy the trip.
